sections.title: The Robust Ten Martini Problem
sections.abstract: The authors claim to solve the robust Ten Martini problem by proving Cantor spectrum for a global open class of analytic one-frequency quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators, for every irrational frequency.
sections.claimed_result: A new acceleration-type quantity stable under analytic perturbations yields Cantor spectrum without an arithmetic restriction on irrational frequency.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Type I analytic one-frequency quasiperiodic Schrödinger operators; all irrational frequencies in a global open class of potentials.
sections.caveat: New preprint; the claimed solution requires expert verification.

sections.title: The tautological ring of M_25 is not Gorenstein
sections.abstract: The paper claims that the tautological ring of M_25 is not Gorenstein, disproving Faber’s 1993 conjecture, and deduces completeness of the Faber–Zagier relations on M_25.
sections.claimed_result: Non-Gorensteinness of the tautological ring and completeness of the Faber–Zagier relations on M_25.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: The tautological ring of the moduli space M_25.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not expose the certificate in enough detail for independent assessment.

sections.title: A universality result for the critical 2d stochastic heat flow
sections.abstract: The authors prove convergence under diffusive scaling to the critical two-dimensional stochastic heat flow for broad discrete and continuum model classes.
sections.claimed_result: Finite-dimensional-distribution convergence in measure-valued stochastic flows for the stated model classes.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Models with a linear-flow property, including finite-range discrete models and Gaussian-noise continuum models.
sections.caveat: The stated convergence mode is finite-dimensional distribution convergence, not automatically path-space convergence.

sections.title: Sharp gradient bounds for uniformly elliptic PDE, eigenvalue asymptotics, and the Landis conjecture
sections.abstract: The paper gives sharp gradient estimates for uniformly elliptic Dirichlet problems and applies them to eigenvalue asymptotics and quantitative Landis-conjecture results.
sections.claimed_result: Improved results for more general operators and weaker coefficient regularity using sharp Harnack, duality, and rescaling methods.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Linear second-order uniformly elliptic equations; exact hypotheses are theorem-specific.
sections.caveat: The abstract omits the exact constants and quantifiers needed for applications.

sections.title: Cauchy laws for zeta logarithmic derivatives and stationary Stieltjes transforms
sections.abstract: The authors prove an unconditional Cauchy limit for a symmetrically truncated Stieltjes transform of projected zeta-zero ordinates and extend related limits to finite-field zeta functions.
sections.claimed_result: Cauchy limits for zeta-related Stieltjes transforms under a stated zero-displacement condition, plus finite-field analogues with explicit errors.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Critical-line logarithmic derivatives under the paper’s o(T) condition; finite-field pure cohomological factors.
sections.caveat: This is not a proof of the Riemann Hypothesis.

sections.title: Low moments of Hecke eigenvalue sums
sections.abstract: The paper claims better-than-square-root cancellation for Sato–Tate random multiplicative-function sums and upper bounds for low moments of Hecke eigenvalue sums.
sections.claimed_result: Low-moment upper bounds using multiplicative chaos and a derandomization argument, with Hecke s-norms as a new ingredient.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Sato–Tate random multiplicative functions and the specified Hecke eigenvalue/eigenform regimes.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not state numerical ranges or sharpness of the bounds.

sections.title: Cyclic Haagerup-Izumi fusion categories at every odd order
sections.abstract: The paper constructs a complex spherical fusion category with cyclic Haagerup–Izumi fusion rules for every odd n at least 3 and deduces pseudo-unitary existence.
sections.claimed_result: An explicit coefficient construction, algebraic completion, and categorical reconstruction yielding the claimed family.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Complex spherical fusion categories with cyclic Haagerup–Izumi fusion rules for odd n at least 3.
sections.caveat: Formal verification of coefficient identities does not verify every categorical step.

sections.title: The coherent KLR sheaf
sections.abstract: The authors construct type-A KLR algebras as affine sections of a coherent sheaf and geometrically extend an sl2 action to a Witt action.
sections.claimed_result: A sheaf-theoretic realization of KLR algebras, geometric explanation of the sl2 action, a Witt-action extension, and a geometric cellular interpretation.
sections.assumptions_and_setting: Type-A KLR algebras and coherent sheaves on products of projective spaces.
sections.caveat: The abstract does not specify the exact sheaf and parameter conventions for each claim.
